name: Remotion
role: React-component video renderer with CLI and Lambda; company licence above 3 employees
summary: Framework where each frame is a React component of the current frame number; headless Chrome renders frames and FFmpeg encodes MP4, WebM, ProRes or GIF. CLI, Node API, Studio preview, and Lambda or Cloud Run for distributed renders. Distinguishing strength: mature React ecosystem, typed props for data-driven video. Per ADR 0001 a reference for VCR, not a dependency. Source-available licence, not OSI open source.
use_when: Data-driven React video you need to ship now, outside VCR's pipeline
Parametrised batch renders with typed props and distributed rendering on Lambda
Reference for frame-as-function-of-time design and its Studio and caption tooling
avoid_when: Inside VCR proper: ADR 0001 builds the compositor in-house; Playwright plus FFmpeg for capture
Non-React or native sources: FFmpeg filtergraphs, or HyperFrames for plain HTML
Company with more than 3 employees and no budget: a company licence is required
Alpha-layer frames for a later compositor: Playwright via @vcr/capture (seek, settle, screenshot)
license: Remotion License: free for individuals, non-profits, evaluation and for-profits up to 3 employees; Company License required otherwise (remotion.pro); terms change in Remotion 5.0
notes: 2026-10-26: LICENSE.md states the licence will change in Remotion 5.0 but does not say how; recheck before any use. Employee counting rules are not defined on that page; see remotion.pro/faq.

assessment.rationale: npm 4.0.539 published 2026-10-26; releases are near-daily. Licence is source-available: free up to 3 employees, otherwise a paid Company License, and it changes in 5.0. Kept as reference per ADR 0001.
